extName.description: Extension name shown in the browser and the Chrome Web Store.

extDescription.message: Switch between Recommended, Info and Comments in the right sidebar while the video keeps playing. No scrolling down.

tabRelated.description: Tab label for the recommended videos.

tabDescription.description: Tab label for the video description.

tabComments.description: Tab label for the comment section.

tabPlaylist.description: Tab label for a playlist or mix that is playing.

tabQueue.description: Tab label for the queue (videos added with "Add to queue").

tabChat.description: Tab label for the live chat or chat replay.

tabAd.description: Tab label for an ad panel YouTube shows in the sidebar.

tabMore.description: Tab label for a side panel without a title.
